ios.desc: Open-source multimodal LLM visual analysis utility. Build & share AI vision prompts augmented with native device sensor data.

android.desc: Configure custom prompts to use multimodal LLMs to analyze your environment using your phone's camera, location, and other available sensor data.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Open-source multimodal multitool written by A.I

quotes.text:
CrayEye is an open-source (Flutter/Dart) multimodal LLM visual analysis utility. made to build & share AI vision prompts augmented with native device sensor data.

Homepage: https://www.crayeye.com

GitHub: https://github.com/alexdredmon/crayeye

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/crayeye/id6480090992

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.crayeye.app

This app was made with AI - read more about that via https://www.alexandriaredmon.com/blog/the-app-that-ai-made

Sharing an open-source project written by A.I. towards the end of making it easier to quickly experiment with multimodal vision models on mobile devices.

Any thoughts/contributions are welcome!

Additional info and screenshots are available via https://www.crayeye.com/

You can read more about the process of making this app via https://www.alexandriaredmon.com/blog/the-app-that-ai-made

iOS and Android platforms are supported:

- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/crayeye/id6480090992
 - Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.crayeye.app
